How do I configure the Trivy vulnerability database for offline use before scanning our yarn.lock?","Please walk me through scanning go.sum for vulnerabilities with Trivy in an environment where internet access is blocked, and save the output as vulnerability JSON."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e074","prompts":["我们仓库收到一个依赖漏洞的提醒，帮我查一下这个 alert 的详细信息，比如影响的版本范围和修复建议。","我想看看最近那个关于 lodash 的依赖安全告警具体内容，包括严重程度和有没有可用的补丁版本。","帮我获取一下仓库里编号 42 的 dependabot 告警的详情，我要在周会上汇报这个风险。","Reactor 依赖好像有个安全漏洞，帮我查一下 GitHub 上这个仓库对应的告警信息，确认受影响的版本。","帮我看下 dependabot 报的那个 transitive dependency 的漏洞详情，我需要判断是否要紧急升级。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e075","prompts":["我有一个 warehouse 的 allocation 问题：三个仓、八个门店，各有 capacity 和 demand，还有运输成本，帮我用 PySCIPOpt 建模求最小总成本。","车间有 5 台机器和 12 个 job，每个 job 的加工时间不一样，有 due date，帮我建一个 MILP 模型最小化总 tardiness，用 SCIP 求解。","帮我把这个 staff scheduling 问题用 PySCIPOpt 写出来：每天三班，每人每周最多上五个班，还要满足最少在岗人数的 hard constraint。","我们想做 bin packing：一批不同尺寸的 item 装进容量 100 的箱子，目标是最少箱子数，penalty 加上超软容量的部分，用 SCIP 解一下。","这个 routing 场景是 8 个客户点从 depot 出发，车辆有载重限制，帮我用 PySCIPOpt 建 VRP 模型，soft constraint 是迟到要罚钱。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e076","prompts":["I recorded a webinar that starts with a title slide and a minute of silence—can you detect how much leading silence there is so I can trim it?","Before cutting these lecture videos, I need to find the low-energy segments at the beginning of each file where the professor was still setting up. Where does the actual speech start?","My podcast episodes all have varying amounts of dead air at the start before the intro music. Can you analyze the audio energy and tell me the timestamp where the intro begins?","There's pre-roll room noise at the head of this interview recording that I want to strip out. Can you figure out how many seconds of low energy precede the first speaker?","I batch-record demo videos and suspect some have long silent openings while I switch slides. How can I turn it into a structured graph and check that every path terminates properly?","I'm writing an interactive fiction with conditional dialogue. Can you parse my script into a graph format so I can visualize the conversation flow and find unreachable branches?","Help me serialize my chatbot's conversation tree to JSON so the runtime can load it, and validate that no node has missing transition targets.","I need to compare two versions of a customer support dialogue flow. Can I build graphs from both scripts and see which branches were added or removed?","My narrative design has around forty decision points. I want to lay it out visually as a directed graph to spot dead ends and loops—what's the easiest way?"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e080","prompts":["我有几张养老院改造项目的 CAD 图纸，需要把房间边界、门洞位置和扶手都提取成结构化的 JSON 数据，方便后续做无障碍审查。","帮我把这个建筑的 DXF 平面图解析一下，按语义图层区分墙体、门和洁具，输出机器可读的房间列表。","我们需要批量处理医院平面图，提取每个房间的净尺寸、门宽以及卫生间里有没有安装 grab bar，最后汇总成 JSON 报表。","装修公司给的图纸是 DXF 格式，我想要一份包含每个房间门窗位置和固定装置清单的结构化数据，可以做自动化校验。","做轮椅通行分析之前，我需要从建筑图纸里提取门洞宽度和走廊转弯处的 clearance，能帮我从 DXF 图层里规范化输出这些数据吗？"],"rubric":[]}]}
